recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait of a person with wet, blonde hair and dark, smudged eye makeup, featuring a blue lollipop that has stained the tongue a matching vibrant cyan. The composition is tight, focusing on the eyes and mouth, with a desaturated, slightly grainy film texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Color match between the lollipop and the tongue stain
Contrast between warm skin tones and cool cyan accents
Juxtaposition of messy wet hair with sharp, dark eyeliner
Symmetry of the facial features anchored by the central lollipop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 90% of the frame, centered vertically and horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright blue lollipop and stained tongue at the bottom-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's dark-rimmed eyes, move down the nose to the open mouth and the lollipop.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, limited to the blurred background visible through hair strands.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale peach and beige (skin and hair tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (eye makeup and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall saturation with high-saturation pops in the blue elements; mid-range values with crushed blacks.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm reds or yellows in the mouth area
Keep background colors muted and desaturated

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a black rectangular badge

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in a utilitarian, industrial block style.
graphicDevices: Solid black rectangular background for text
White border around the text block

preserve: The blocky, stacked nature of the corner label
The high-contrast black and white color scheme

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up of a person with wet blonde hair, dark eyeliner, and an open mouth with a blue-stained tongue and a blue lollipop. Use a desaturated, grainy film aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small, black rectangular badge in the bottom-left corner with white, bold, condensed sans-serif text stacked in three lines.

Is the text badge in the bottom-left corner?
Is the overall color palette desaturated except for the blue?
